Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1 TENDER ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: [a] The bidder with past performance of satisfactory execution of contracts to SC Railway/Other Zon al Railways/PUs/Central Govt/State Govt/PSUs for supply of the same / similar items for a quantity of 20 percent or more of tendered quantity against a single contract during last three years prior to, an d excluding tender opening date shall be considered as responsive to SC Railways requirements for placement of bulk and regular order. bidders are requested to submit the past performance report s uch as Copies of R Notes/CRAC/Proof of acceptance of material by consignee etc. along with their off er; failing which offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. SIMILAR ITEM: Any size of mobile iron barricade [b] In case, the bidder participates as an authorized dealer, then the performance as required above shall be that of Principal (OEM) authorizing the agent or bidder for the same OEM. It may so happen t hat the agent/dealer has credentials of past supply for a different Principal/OEM, then it will not be co nsidered as performance. For Authorised dealers, tender specific authorization from OEM has to be u ploaded with bid. 2 3

4 Payment Terms: The standard payment terms subject to recoveries, if any, under the liquidated damages clause and general condition of contract will be as under:- 100% payment will be made against receipt and acceptance of the material by t he consignee. Note: Bill passing officer to ensure the validity of PBG/WSD to cover warranty obligations as per the contract before passing the final bill. 5 Other conditions: 6 Penalty Clause: 1. After having been notified of the defects / service requirement during warranty period, Seller has to complete the required Service / Rectification within 7 days time limit (or as specified in other terms in contract). 2. If the Seller fails to complete service / rectification within the defined time limit, a penalty of 0 .5% of Unit Price of the product shall be charged as penalty for each week of delay from the se ller. Seller can deposit the penalty with the Buyer directly else the Buyer shall have a right to r ecover all such shall be charged as penalty or recover all such penalty amount from the Warra nty Performance Security (WPBG) for each week of delay from the seller. 3. Cumulative Penalty cannot exceed more than 5% of the total contract value after which the B uyer shall have the right to get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the ri sk and cost of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cos t of such service /get the service / rectification done from alternate sources at the risk and cos t of the Seller besides forfeiture of WPBG. Seller shall be liable to reimburse the cost of such s ervice / rectification to the Buyer. 4. Bad performance in supply/warranty obligations etc. in this contract shall be recorded and dul y taken into consideration while taking decision in future tenders issued from Indian Railways. Bad performance shall include, but not limited to, failure to honour timelines/ conditions specif ied in contract, PO cancellation on suppliers account, repeated DP extension, poor warranty/A MC support etc. 7 Consignee Details (For delivery and payment matters): Name: Mr. S VIVEKANANDA MOHAN, Designation: Sub Inspector/QM/VIJAYAWADA.
